doc.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025

title: Spotting hits: Burt Bacharach and Dion at Bell Sound
summary: Bacharach and Hal David asked her which side was a hit; both sides of a Dion record took off.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: I wonder if you ever had an experience where you did a demo and you said to yourself, “This is going to be a hit.” You recognized it as the potential.

Yeah. Some Burt Bacharach things. Because I did a lot for Burt. And I remember being at Bell Sound, there was a guy named Domenick Romeo who did all of the mastering right there. They did the mastering there. And I was walking past his room and Burt and Hal were there and they said, “Annie come in and tell us which side is a hit.” And I think it was Dion. I think it was the first Dion. And I think they put it back-to-back and then had to split it because both sides were taking off.
Wow. They were both A sides. Yeah.
